# Editorial Instagram Post — Style Reference

> editorial on deep violet

**Theme:** dark

Measurements come from a 1080 × 1350 Instagram Post composition (4:5) and are exact; roles and recommendations are interpreted. Copy and imagery shown are this composition's current content — swap them freely and keep the palette, type, spacing, components and layout below.

An editorial Instagram Post, led by DM Serif Display headline type at 126px weight 400 on a deep violet canvas, with light violet (#cda9e8) as the accent. The product image anchors the upper-center, covering ~27% of the canvas; the layout is comfortable, center-aligned, with a 40px safe margin.

## Colors

| Name | Value | Role |
|------|------|------|
| Deep Violet | `#181126` | Canvas background |
| Pale Peach | `#faf4e9` | Primary brand color; Eyebrow text; Headline text; Body Copy text |
| Light Violet | `#cda9e8` | Secondary brand color; Call-to-Action Button background |
| Black | `#111111` | Call-to-Action Button text |

## Typography

### Manrope — Sans used for eyebrow, body copy, call-to-action button
- **Substitute:** Inter, Roboto, or the ui-sans-serif/system-ui stack
- **Weights:** 500, 700, 800
- **Sizes:** 25px, 26px, 29px
- **Line height:** 1.10–1.35
- **Letter spacing:** 3.6px at 26px, 2.5px at 25px
- **Role:** Sans used for eyebrow, body copy, call-to-action button

### DM Serif Display — Serif used for headline
- **Substitute:** Source Serif 4, Georgia, or ui-serif as fallback
- **Weights:** 400
- **Sizes:** 126px
- **Line height:** 1.00
- **Letter spacing:** 0
- **Role:** Serif used for headline

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing |
|------|------|------|------|------|------|
| cta | Manrope | 800 | 25px | 1.10 | 2.5px |
| eyebrow | Manrope | 700 | 26px | 1.20 | 3.6px |
| body | Manrope | 500 | 29px | 1.35 | — |
| title | DM Serif Display | 400 | 126px | 1.00 | — |

## Spacing & Shapes

**Base unit:** 4px

**Density:** comfortable

### Spacing Scale

| Token | Value |
|------|------|
| Text gap | 20px |
| Component gap | 28px |
| Content gap | 40px |
| Section gap | 56px |
| Section gap 2 | 60px |
| Section gap 3 | 80px |
| Hero spacing | 168px |

### Border Radius

| Element | Value |
|------|------|
| Shape | 0px |
| Product Image | 0px |
| Call-to-Action Button | 999px |

### Layout

- **Canvas:** 1080 × 1350px (4:5)
- **Safe margin:** 40px
- **Element gap:** 80px
- **Text alignment:** center

## Components

### Shape ×2
**Role:** Decorative or container shape

rectangle filled radial-gradient(ellipse 62% 46% at 50% 40%, #CDA9E870 0%, #CDA9E800 72%). Sits center-center, 100% × 100% of the canvas.

### Eyebrow ×2
**Role:** Small kicker above the headline that sets context

Text #faf4e9, no background. Manrope 26px weight 700, line-height 1.20, letter-spacing 3.6px, left-aligned. Sits top-left, spanning 50% of the canvas width. Copy budget ~15 characters.

### Product Image
**Role:** Product shot — the object being sold

contain fit, square corners. Sits upper-center, covering ~27% of the canvas. Imagery: Frosted glass serum bottle with a dropper cap on a stone plinth, lit by a single soft spotlight.

### Headline
**Role:** Primary headline — the first read of the composition

Text #faf4e9, no background. DM Serif Display 126px weight 400, line-height 1.00, center-aligned. Sits lower-center, spanning 84% of the canvas width. Copy budget ~15 characters.

### Body Copy
**Role:** Descriptive supporting copy

Text #faf4e9, no background. Manrope 29px weight 500, line-height 1.35, center-aligned. Sits bottom-center, spanning 80% of the canvas width. Copy budget ~45 characters.

### Call-to-Action Button
**Role:** The one action the viewer should take

Text #111111, background #cda9e8, border-radius 999px. Manrope 25px weight 800, line-height 1.10, letter-spacing 2.5px, center-aligned. Sits bottom-center, spanning 32% of the canvas width. Copy budget ~15 characters.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do
- Use Manrope at 26px/29px/25px for eyebrow, body copy, call-to-action button; don't substitute another family at these sizes
- Use DM Serif Display at 126px for headline; don't substitute another family at these sizes
- Take every text and surface color from the Colors palette
- Keep 999px on Call-to-Action Button — these are the structural radii
- Keep the 40px safe margin and ~80px rhythm between stacked slots on a 4px base unit
- Keep text center-aligned
- Glow: Rectangle panel with background radial-gradient(ellipse 62% 46% at 50% 40%, #CDA9E870 0%, #CDA9E800 72%), opacity 1 and 0px corner radius; preserve its authored geometry and gradient stops.
- Floor glow: Rectangle panel with background radial-gradient(closest-side, #CDA9E88C, #CDA9E800), opacity 1 and 0px corner radius; preserve its authored geometry and gradient stops.
- CTA pill: Editable call to action with the exact label "Shop the launch", #CDA9E8 fill, #111111 text, center alignment and 999px corner radius.
- Swap copy and imagery freely; keep slot sizes, positions and styles

### Don't
- Don't introduce colors outside the palette
- Don't add text or elements beyond the slots in Layout
- Don't use clutter, generic stock-poster styling or illegible type
- Don't let slots overlap by accident or leave the safe area

## Elevation

- **All slots:** flat, no shadow — depth comes from layering order, scale and color contrast

Image style: Render as a photorealistic image: true-to-life materials and textures, natural lighting with accurate shadows and reflections, realistic depth of field, as if shot on a professional camera. Apply it to the whole image without changing the specified text, colors or layout.

1080 × 1350 Instagram Post canvas (4:5) with comfortable density — slots cover ~51% of the canvas. Text is center-aligned inside a 40px safe margin, and the product image anchors the upper-center. Slots, back-to-front — positions and sizes are relative to the canvas:

- Eyebrow 2 (eyebrow), top-right, at 45% / 3%, 50% × 3% of the canvas (≈540 × 41 px): copy up to ~20 characters, currently “LUMEN · 12 MARCH”.

- Body (body), bottom-center, at 10% / 83%, 80% × 5% of the canvas (≈864 × 68 px): copy up to ~45 characters, currently “Plant-powered hydration that lasts all day.”.
